failure_selection: First other failed paired N20 snapshot in C/E/IID order; if absent search paired N5, N2, N10 in that order, same snapshot order
fixed_pair: N20 B0 versus initial-selected by that N development data
fixed_snapshot: First C state in frozen manifest order
rendering: Replay stored actions, verify every observation, no policy inference or new scored episodes
unavailable_failure: Record absence for these fixed pairs; do not manufacture failures
